method.window: from mid-December of Y-1 to just before Lunar New Year of Y, named by Y
method.lunar_new_year: Hong Kong Observatory conversion table: the Jan-Feb date labelled 1st Lunar month
method.daily_rule: start = close of the last daily bar dated on or before 12-15 of Y-1; end = close of the last daily bar dated strictly before LNY(Y)
method.weekly_rule: a weekly bar labelled Monday M closes on Friday M+4; start = last weekly bar whose Friday is on or before 12-15 of Y-1; end = last weekly bar whose Friday is strictly before LNY(Y); each end can be up to four trading days earlier than the daily rule
method.return: end close / start close - 1, in percent
method.length: bars after the start bar up to and including the end bar (daily: trading days; weekly: weeks)
method.dip: lowest close among those bars / start close - 1; weekly uses weekly closes only
method.share_up: share of windows with end close > start close; Wilson 95% interval, z = 1.96
method.baseline: every start bar in the sample period held for L bars, L = the sample's median window length with a half rounded up; daily period 2008-12-01 to the 2026 window's end, weekly from the first bar whose Friday is on or after 1980-12-01 to the 2008 window's end; overlapping, so no interval
method.verdict_rule: 延續 if the Wilson 95% lower bound of share up > baseline share up; 沒有延續 if share up <= baseline share up; otherwise 分不出
method.legs: leg A = start to the last close dated on or before 12-31 of Y-1 (weekly: last bar whose Friday is on or before 12-31); leg B = that close to the end
method.start_gap_guard: a window is built only if its start close is at most 7 calendar days before the start date and is not the series' first bar
method.duplicates: a bar label that appears twice must carry the same close; the second row is dropped

limitations: The 18 daily windows were seen before registration (EP06, 2026-11-05) and are discovery only; whether other start dates were tried then is unknown.

The validation uses weekly bars: each end of a window can sit up to four trading days from where the daily rule would put it; the weekly-rule check on 2009-2026 measures how often that changes the sign.
The provider revised its weekly history by up to 9.3% and its daily history by up to 1.8% between two fetches; data_versions reports how many window signs that changes.
No independent local source checks the weekly closes before 2013; the FX_IDC check covers 2014-2026 daily only.
The month study's weekly January (1981-2026 pooled) was known at registration and overlaps leg B.
Baseline windows overlap and carry no interval; the verdict compares one interval with one number.
Descriptive only: a calendar window is not a cause, a signal or a forecast.
